intro.heading: Dysphoria
intro.body: Dysphoria is a fifteen-image self-portrait series built like an album, where each frame plays as its own track. Shot in stark black and white, the work resists the usual arc toward healing or resolution. It stays inside the reaction itself — documenting an internal state rather than explaining it away. Contortion, light as current, and abrupt endings stand in for feelings that keep living in the body until they are given somewhere else to go. What remains is not a cure, but a record: an audiovisual document paired with a soundtrack, still living where it was found.

soundtrack.heading: Soundtrack
soundtrack.sub: An accompanying playlist for Dysphoria — listen while you move through the sheets. Apple Music first; Spotify when the mirror is ready.

tracks.title: The Host
tracks.liner: Dysphoria as something that keeps living in the body until it is given somewhere else to go.

tracks.title: Grinding Grit onto Grief
tracks.liner: The body reaches for the ground and never arrives.

tracks.title: A Charlatan's Curse
tracks.liner: Imposter air. The exhaustion of doubting the hand that made the picture.

tracks.title: Funnel
tracks.liner: White light held like current. The mind routed and rerouted.

tracks.title: X-OVER
tracks.liner: Half a face under the drape. One eye in the seam between light and shadow.

tracks.title: Pin
tracks.liner: Maybe it’s dumb to pin significance onto every little thing — but we still do.

tracks.title: trance
tracks.titleDisplay: t r a n c e
tracks.liner: Same current, thinner air. Hands as the wire the feeling runs through.

tracks.title: Sinister & Dexter
tracks.liner: Left and right, white and black, glance and turn.

tracks.title: Grooving Grunge in Grudges
tracks.liner: The stretch pushed further. It hurts — and reminds you that you are still here.

tracks.title: One day
tracks.liner: Near-dark. A short fear of losing the light of reality.

tracks.title: Placebo
tracks.liner: The fading returns of things once loved without effort.

tracks.title: Where does the line end?
tracks.liner: Whether forgiveness only becomes real once a life is over.

tracks.title: Sad People, Big Ambitions
tracks.liner: Title and image already say it. Nothing to add.

tracks.title: The Divided Line
tracks.liner: An abrupt stop on purpose. The record ends before the feeling does.
